title: Mastering Vector Dimensions: Insights & Challenges
description: Vector databases represent data as multi-dimensional vectors, where "dimensions" capture unique numerical features of text, image, or audio data. While higher dimensions can improve precision and model performance, they also introduce challenges like computational overhead and the "curse of dimensionality," often mitigated through dimensionality reduction techniques like PCA and t-SNE.
